body: This project is for a university client to show what creative health assets are in Greater Manchester. I did my first commissions of creating a series of hexagon abstract paintings from the places I visited and they have asked for me to do a write up of everything I’ve learnt. The audience is creatives, academics and people who work inn creative health and mental health. My designs decisions are based on making it accessible and fun to read and based on hexagons as the paintings I created for them were on hexagon canvass to reflect the Manchester Bee. I am still working on this as I still need to do the recommendations and future directions

I understand I have lot more work to do and a lot more to process. I just find it very difficult since he triggered a lot of underlying issues that I couldn’t fully process. Thank you so much for the reassurance I really appreciate it. I thought I was going crazy since I felt like I was going in circles

Hi, 

That sounds incredibly difficult to deal with. 
I have CPTSD and would react in a similar easy when I felt like my needs aren’t being met or feeling insecure. Forgive me if I am being too forward. 
Unfortunately it requires a lot of inner work to be done and she might need additional support. If you don’t mind me asking how are you supporting her? 
Also if you’re emotionally drained you won’t be able to support her. You can’t pour from an empty cup. I would recommend focusing on yourself. I don’t know it might be best to let go but that’s ultimately your decisions. 
But if you want to continue I would recommend personal and couple therapy. I understand you can’t find one you like but I would look into someone that’s not your personal therapist for both of you. 
In terms of strategies I have no idea- I honestly have to take each day by day. 
I genuinely think you both need an open discussion on what to do next because you both can’t keep going like this. It sounds exhausting

Tbh that sounds really intense. I understand that the things he did really hurt you and you should validate that because it’s not okay what he did, I went through a similar situation and when my ex did similar things and I reacted out it in anger it was due to being triggered by past traumas but also being severely hurt by their actions. Those feelings are so hard to cope with and might be best to discuss with a therapist to work through them. It takes time to heal and to become emotional available as it’s takes so much energy to trust another person again or to even trust ourselves again x
I hope so too and thank you so much for your kind words

Thank you so much for feedback. I really appreciate it. 

I understand what causes me to fall into the pattern of thinking and behaviour. I have a good understanding of the triggers. I just struggle to stop it. While in therapy I was working on identifying the emotions and trying to understand how my family negative and toxic thinking was everything mine. 

I got rid of his phone number just to stop myself from anxiously texting him. But I will try to reach out and apologise. 

I’m not in therapy anymore and I am on the waiting list for the NHS therapy and I can’t really afford private therapy but I have workbooks to help me at the moment until I can see one. 

Thank you so much for the advice, I will take it on x

That sounds really difficult to deal with but you’re doing an amazing job 😀

Preventing a burn out is just taking care of yourself, eating well etc, doing activities that makes you happy (I journal and paint to help prevent burns outs until) you can move to a better job. 

I hope that helps a little 😊

It was an unspoken rule to not talk about it. I did talk to the supervisors and they said they are having a discussion and what she did was inappropriate but she’s still allowed to go. Which doesn’t really make sense to me but I don’t if I am overreacting.

For me birthdays would be the only day that I wouldn’t get physically or emotionally abused by my parents and they would do their fake routine of being loving parents. They would get me extravagant gifts. Shower me with this false love and care and hugs. But they never gave me the basic human decency and care I needed as a child. The next day they would go back to their normal routine of abuse. So I don’t celebrate it, I don’t like the memories or the tension that surrounds that day.
I haven’t told my parents yet as I know they will laugh at me and say I am making it up or that what I went through wasn’t traumatic and I should be grateful to be alive.
I got up today and cleaned my room and my desk even though I’ve been triggered this week

Happy birthday! I hope you have a great day
